abilities.name: Acid Flask
abilities.description: Throw a glass acid flask onto a ground tile; shatter into a persistent corrosive pool.

cast.description: Small glass flask toss, liquid slosh and a quick airy whistle, alchemical fantasy.

impact.description: Crisp small glass shatter with a wet acid splash and sizzling tail.

sustain.description: Quiet seamless corrosive puddle bubbling with sparse small bubble pops and chemical hiss.

notes: Spec flight is 800 ms after release; hold-targeting adds no throw power.
Game owns 6-tile range,1.5-tile pool radius,15 s lifetime and 8 s cooldown.
38 px field is a compact presentation motif; gameplay radius remains explicit, not inferred from its canvas.

abilities.name: Ironskin Draft
abilities.description: Instant self-protection: drink a draft and flash into metallic skin with a restrained golden shimmer.

cast.description: Potion cork click and brief sip blended into an immediate metallic alchemy chime.

impact.description: Crystalline hardening chime, layered soft steel resonance, protective and compact.

sustain.description: Very quiet seamless metallic shimmer with occasional tiny golden chimes.

notes: Instant activation: cosmetic 600 ms actor gesture must not delay protection.
Self only;8 s protection,40 percent damage reduction,12 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Siphon
abilities.description: Draw dark red life motes from a nearby consenting ally into the Alchemist during a breakable channel.

cast.description: Dark red energy connection snapping softly into place, low resonant pulse.

impact.description: Soft vital pulse at ally drain contact, restrained organic magical thrum.

charge.description: Subtle dark energy gathers into a low harmonic hum over half a second.

sustain.description: Seamless deep harmonic siphon hum with measured inward energy pulses.

notes: Life travels FROM ally TO Alchemist; ally is not an enemy target.
500 ms setup; channel up to 8 s; game owns consent/range/interruption and health thresholds.
Actor channel tag loops independently; full preview includes illustrative release.

abilities.name: Transmute
abilities.description: Channel a gold alchemical connection into a ground item, then resolve a brief material-conversion flash.

cast.description: Bright alchemical release, small bronze seal click and brief gilded shimmer.

impact.description: A precise golden material-conversion sparkle with granular crystal settling.

charge.description: Measured alchemical harmonic rise with fine metallic grains assembling over one and a half seconds.

notes: Game owns 2-tile range,1.5 s cast,6 s cooldown and uncertain outcome.
Resolution flash is neutral; does not promise a rare item or include batch/guaranteed-upgrade effects.
